notes.title: LavaLoop V0.3.2.2 🏆 FLIP JURY AWARD
notes.content: [p]Update following the FLIP! I had the honor of receiving the JURY AWARD. I'm so happy! I received a lot of feedback over the three days of game presentations, and the jury gave me constructive comments that will help me make major choices for future updates. Here is a first series of changes that don't add any content but improve the gaming experience:[/p][p]Improvements and gameplay comfort:[/p][list][*][p] Better synchronization and more flexibility in rhythm mechanics[/p][/*][*][p]Super attack every 8 beats: The player can move while pressing \[JUMP] to validate the super attack (several players move continuously and were unable to launch the 5-beam special attack).[/p][/*][*][p]Once injured, if the player can't get up in time after three hits, it get up automatically.[/p][/*][*][p]The color gauge no longer decreases if you stay still.[/p][/*][*][p]Pressing A during transitions between levels increases the color gauge.[/p][/*][/list][p]Fixes:[/p][list][*][p]The player often fall through platforms while falling. This has been fixed![/p][/*][*][p]The "press A" prompt every 8 beats wasn't displayed when in the air. This has been fixed![/p][/*][*][p]The 2 Giant Circular Saw levels: Improved timing and level flow.[/p][/*][*][p]Ladybug Mini-boss: Fixed the last phase where some spike balls would randomly launch.[/p][/*][*][p]Chains no longer target enemies which can only be destroyed with the super beam.[/p][/*][*][p]The music would sometimes cut out when returning to the main menu.[/p][/*][/list][p]Visual Effects:[/p][list][*][p]Platforms dance and flash, like in "Crypt of the Necrodancer" 😊[/p][/*][*][p]Jolting effect when landing on platforms[/p][/*][*][p]Jumping between levels no longer displays a lag on levels with giant circular saws.[/p][/*][*][p]Various improvements (smoke effect at the base of musical beams, more colorful platforms in the level with rings)[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45049089/86a17359f17dcacd2552baf202b7f2b138887f9c.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: LavaLoop - v0.3.1.18 update
notes.content:
“Not a rhythm game” update
Following the last playtest feedback, the goal of this update is to simplify the rhythm gameplay so you can fully enjoy the game and learn the basics of rhythm games little by little without ever being penalized. I also want to make the rhythm game interface both readable and unobtrusive:
-	New UI for the metronome: you can switch between partitions, pendulum, pulsations or none => Don’t hesitate to tell me which one you prefer or if one of them turn out to be useless.
-	The (A) on the 8th beat is now around the player, so it’s more visible.
-	The (A) on the 8th beat always appears (no matter if you weren’t in rhythm before)
-	The tolerance to rhythmic errors is more permissive.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45049089/107a71b10ef1715b206d4d50c4a040042d4d2539.gif[/img]

notes.title: LavaLoop - v0.3.1.1.7 update ➡️ Spawn Angoulême
notes.content:
Here is a new update for my LavaLoop playtests!
- new "credits" system. Each "Continue" cost one credit. You will find some credit coins in game. The Arcade mode is now really challenging 🙂
- new vfx for coins or credits
- new UI infos at the bottom of the "pause" screen with credits, coins and robot scrap.
- bug fix for the rhythm gameplay
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45049089/b4156047622d0cd434b5dbb96402a71b83617e66.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Changelog (v0.3.1.16) Mac support
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45049089/47a6d90d88db287f9bcec20390454252c322499a.jpg[/img]
[h3]New playtest version (0.3.1.16)[/h3]
- Mac version now supported (there was an issue with Wwise integration, it should work just fine now)
- "easy mode" for the rhythm gameplay - it should be much easier for players who don't like rhythm-based game (a new window allow you to choose the "easy mode" at the start of a new game)
- new settings for visual confort (turn on/off effects, camera shake, particles, flash light...)
- new images for the skills tutorial
- small UI improvements
- other small fix...

[h3]🎮 If you want to take part in the current playtest, send me a message :)[/h3]
